 Memphis Grizzlies Washington Wizards The  Memphis Grizzlies  (9-4) and  Washington Wizards  (4-10) meet for the first of two matchups in 2026-2027. Last season, the Wizards won both matchups against the Grizzlies.
--> The  Memphis Grizzlies  (9-4) and  Washington Wizards  (4-10) meet for the first of two matchups in 2026-2027. Last season, the Wizards won both matchups against the Grizzlies.
 The Grizzlies are 33-26 all-time in the regular season against the Wizards, including 24-6 at home and 9-20 on the road.
--> The Grizzlies are 33-26 all-time in the regular season against the Wizards, including 24-6 at home and 9-20 on the road.
 Most recently, the Wizards are coming off a, 147-119, loss against the Houston Rockets.
--> Most recently, the Wizards are coming off a, 147-119, loss against the Houston Rockets.
 One key matchup to watch: Grizzlies rookie power forward Cameron Boozer against Anthony Davis. Boozer is averaging 15.5 points, just under 9.7 rebounds and 5.2 assists, while Davis is averaging 24.7 points, 10.2 rebounds, 1.2 steals and 1.1 blocks.
--> One key matchup to watch: Grizzlies rookie power forward Cameron Boozer against Anthony Davis. Boozer is averaging 15.5 points, just under 9.7 rebounds and 5.2 assists, while Davis is averaging 24.7 points, 10.2 rebounds, 1.2 steals and 1.1 blocks.
 Most recently, the Grizzlies are coming off a, 129-110   win over the Brooklyn Nets. In that game, Grizzlies swingman Cedric Coward finished with 23 points, (converting on seven of his 12 shot attempts), 12 rebounds, four assists, two steals and two blocks. Forward Taylor Hendricks contributed 22 points, five rebounds and four assists off the bench.
